prompt:
Complete all reading and language tasks on this page: Read and review: planning and possibilities. When we share accurate information, planning becomes easier. If an address is wrong, a letter can go to the wrong home. Maria’s invitation went to her old address, but we found the mistake together. If we check the remaining addresses today, we will avoid repeating that mistake. If I had more free time, I would check every detail myself. In reality, I need help, and I am grateful for my friends. 1. What went wrong with Maria’s invitation?
2. Which two sentences express general relationships?
3. Which sentence describes a realistic future possibility?
4. Which sentence describes an imagined present situation? Complete: If we _____ (confirm) the list today, we _____ (send) the invitations tomorrow. Complete: If Clarice _____ (have) more time, she _____ (check) every detail herself. Then write an imaginary situation of your own.
